title: Has anyone seen this library?
content: If this isn't the right sub for this please let me know. This was just the closest I could find to the right sub. I recently had a dream that prominently featured a library like this. It was all stark white and sort of pearlescent except for the books themselves, which were realistic old hardcover books in various conditions and colors. In a way it reminded me of the art/color style from the game Manifold Garden(except the books), but not exactly. It was more ethereal-feeling. The shelves themselves were about chest height. It was so flat that I could see the repeating sets of shelves going on for a while in all directions except for the way I came in. There was no visible ceiling, only a mixture of white and blue fog fading and shifting into itself. This whole dream was so vivid. It felt more real than waking life. I need to know if anyone else has seen this or if it's just something my brain made. Thank you!
